steps.title: Add result caching layer
steps.description: Implement a caching layer for filter results. Create a `FilterCache` class/object that stores filter results keyed by a hash of the filter parameters. `cachedFilter(filters)` should check the cache first and only compute if the result isn't cached. Cache entries expire after 60 seconds. Print `'cache hit'` or `'cache miss'` for each request to verify caching behavior.
hints: Create a cache key by JSON-stringifying the sorted filter object: JSON.stringify({ category, search, sort })
Store cache entries as { result, expiresAt } where expiresAt = Date.now() + 60000
Make cachedFilter return a wrapper that checks cache before calling filterProducts

verification.successMessage: Caching layer works — first request misses, repeated request hits!
verification.failureMessage: Print 'cache miss' on first request and 'cache hit' on the second request with the same filter params.
